title: How to connect to Dynamics 365 Business Central On-Premises in VS Code (Use the On-Premises version for customization)
summary: This post explains how to configure VS Code to connect to a Business Central On-Premises environment for AL development. It covers modifying the launch.json file with correct server settings, enabling Developer Services in the BC instance configuration, and verifying authentication methods.
key_points: Update launch.json with the actual On-Premises server URL and instance name from the BC web interface or PowerShell commands
Enable DeveloperServicesEnabled and configure the DeveloperServicesPort in CustomSettings.config or using Set-NAVServerConfiguration
Verify your authentication method (Windows is typical for On-Premises) and confirm it matches the launch.json configuration
Avoid using On-Premises environments for SaaS extension development as available methods differ between the two versions
The CRONUS demo license now includes RIMDX permissions on all objects, enabling partners to test with AppSource apps in on-premises environments
